clusters.name: CBD Inbound Commuter Arterials (AM Peak)
clusters.description: High directional peak demand entering core business district between 07:30 and 09:30, overwhelming intersection entry approaches.

clusters.name: Outbound Regional Trunk Merge (PM Peak)
clusters.description: Heavy evening commuter egress between 16:30 and 18:30 causing downstream merge bottlenecks and queue spillback.

clusters.name: Signal-Constrained Dense Junction Approaches
clusters.description: Severe capacity bottleneck caused by shared turning movements and split cycles at multi-phase signalized intersections.

clusters.name: Geometric Capacity & Lane Discontinuity
clusters.description: Recurring shockwave formation where 3-lane trunk segments neck down into 2-lane or 1-lane configurations.

PROJ-LANE-EW-TRU.title: East-West Trunk Lane Expansion (+1 Travel Lane)
PROJ-LANE-EW-TRU.description: Add a 4th dedicated through lane along EW-TRU-00004 (N0002 -> N0003), expanding capacity from 2,549 to 4,500 vph.

PROJ-FLARE-N0001.title: Junction N0001 Turn-Pocket Flare & Intersection Widening
PROJ-FLARE-N0001.description: Construct 150m dedicated left-turn bay approaching N0001, eliminating through-traffic obstruction and increasing green ratio from 0.54 to 0.72.

PROJ-ATSAC-EW-PRI.title: EW-PRI Adaptive Signal Coordination Corridor (Green Wave)
PROJ-ATSAC-EW-PRI.description: Deploy dynamic corridor signal coordination with adaptive cycle splits across N0300 through N0305, achieving uninterrupted platoon flow.

PROJ-FLYOVER-NS-TRU.title: North-South Trunk Elevated Bypass Flyover
PROJ-FLYOVER-NS-TRU.description: Construct 2-lane grade-separated flyover over N0100 intersection, completely removing through traffic from surface signal conflicts.
